defect_found_not_fixed: An unbounded `defer_after_inert` is a trap: nothing clears the guard except a call that fires, so a guard that refuses every call is never cleared. FOUND by the replay parking the desk for ten consecutive adjudications on 20260728T083400Z-E3-sk48-carried-v2. FIXED here by bounding the clause at adapt_max new frames, with a test.

The replay attributed every first-round refusal to the floor, including ten the kind guard had refused. FOUND while reading the per-leg refusal histogram. FIXED: GateDecision now carries the clause that refused and the histogram reports it.

A25's replay judged every leg against g50t level 1's 78 actions; a third of the archive is sk48, whose level 1 is 61. FIXED: each leg is judged against its own env_meta, and the six legs that recorded none borrow their own game's number with the borrowing declared.

`_frames_this_level` still counts failed commands as evidence and the line written into turns.json still calls them transitions. NOT FIXED, unchanged from A25: the switchable form is `actions-unit` and it is off.

files.what: the narrative: what was measured, what was built, what is still unknown

the same, machine-readable: every adjudication with its gap, its trigger kinds, its cost, the after-the-fact verdict A25 published, and the at_call verdict a running arm could have computed the instant the call returned
the cadence census over every leg that ever reached a desk, now carrying the at-call inertia signal beside A25's after-the-fact verdict; human-readable
every constant in the loop that gates how often the arm stops to think, with the effective ratio each imposes
the same, machine-readable, including which legs ran differently under each policy and which policies discriminate inert calls from productive ones

the offline counterfactual: thirteen policies re-decided over the recorded stream, per policy and per leg, with actions bought per dollar under two readings and each leg's own level-1 boundary; human-readable

implemented.armtools/action_economy.py: one pair of replays now yields both windows; the census cross-tabulates them; each leg is judged against its own level-1 baseline; the replay reports per-leg acts/$ under two readings, which legs ran differently, and how many continuation rounds a kind clause would have refused if the gate had been asked.
implemented.inner/economy.py: four levers, all historic by default: `inertia` (compute the signal), `adapt=by_prediction_delta`, `defer_after_inert` (bounded by adapt_max), `min_surprises` (clause skipped at 1), and `gate_every_round` with `gate_continuation`. GateDecision now names the clause that refused. Five new policies.
implemented.inner/inertia.py: compile a book snapshot in a scratch copy, draw one hash per step, and judge two revisions over a named window. `verdict_at_call` is the runtime entry; `bought_nothing` is three-valued.
implemented.inner/loop.py: `_inertia_at_call` computes the verdict after an adjudication and only when a policy asked; the continuation gate is consulted inside the while loop and only under `gate_every_round`.
implemented.tests/test_action_economy_inertia.py: 37 tests, including two archived snapshot pairs as fixtures for the detector.

leg: offline only -- no ARC action, no live model call, no credential read, no sealed-pile contact, no spend.

at_call_vs_after_the_fact.what_it_cannot_see: a rewrite whose only effect is under an action the arm has never taken. Empty on this archive; recorded as absent, not as zero.
at_call_vs_after_the_fact.why_not_luck: 31 of 31 moved-and-changed calls have a tail that diverges at its very first step: `step` is a fold, so a divergence inside the call's own window is still there at every later step.

discrimination_inert_per_productive_beyo.reading: the floors do not discriminate; they spend less. Only the signal-driven levers refuse mostly-inert calls.

money_on_calls_that_bought_nothing.difference: two end-of-leg calls the audit cannot score at all ($8.37 on 20260801T001851Z-R1b-sk48-b, $10.30 on 20260801T044640Z-R2b-sk48-b)

the_lever_that_refuses_nothing.all_of_them: second rounds of a turn, which the historic gate is never asked about

negative_controls: measure-inertia replays to today's numbers in every behavioural field, per leg and pooled -- computing the signal changes no decision, which is what makes every other row readable.
the published A25 census reproduces byte for byte from this checkout (sha256 85b4c0d0...c934a03) BEFORE the refactor, and after it a recursive comparison reports 0 changed values and 3 added keys.
a book revision compared against itself is inert.
a missing snapshot, an uncompilable revision and an empty window are unknowns; the floor moves on none of them and a measurement that raises is an unknown too.
min_surprises at its historic 1 refuses nothing at any pending count.
the defer guard passes a novel kind, an unattributed call, and a call after a productive one -- it refuses a repeat, not the next question.
a default arm never imports inner/inertia.py.
from_env reads 'false' as False rather than through bool().
not_changed: harness/run.py -- the flag's `choices` is built from POLICIES, so five new policies are selectable without editing it. A25's plumbing held.
inner/theorize.py -- REPAIR_ROUNDS is measured and still not a cadence lever.
